fact: In March 2023 the head of government announced publication, before end of April 2023, of the decree on interoperability of administrations and exchange of information and documents between them, under law 55.19 which imposes exchange and interoperability between administrations.
title: Administration: simplification des procédures et interopérabilité
publisher: le360 (revue de presse, Les Inspirations Eco)
